replacements.Una perturbación imperceptible para huma: A perturbation imperceptible to humans added to the input audio produces a transcript containing injected instructions. The model follows those instructions as if the user had spoken them.

replacements.El atacante define el texto que quiere v: The attacker defines the text they want to appear in the transcript: "Ignore all previous instructions and…"
replacements.Se calculan los gradientes del modelo de: Gradients of the transcription model with respect to the input audio are computed to maximize the probability of the target transcript.
replacements.El delta se proyecta a una bola L∞ de ra: The delta is projected onto an L∞ ball with a small radius ε. The resulting signal sounds identical to the original.
replacements.El operador escucha exactamente la misma: The operator hears exactly the same voice and the same message. Nothing sounds different from the original audio.
